verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a plugin platform with a manifest schema and MCP-backed APIs could reasonably publish versioned APIs and a deprecation policy, but the evidence documents neither. The closest item says legacy `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` files 'remain supported as a compatibility fallback.' That is a one-off compatibility note, not a versioning scheme or deprecation timeline. MCP server changes are also picked up automatically without any versioning described, and no OpenAPI spec was found.
